arStrings.szText: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Dealing Cold damage has up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} chance to grant you a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*Affix."Static Value 2"|1%|]{/c}.
